name: Nebraska
sources: NE DOR 2026 Tax Calculation Schedule, Form 8-460-2026 (draft as of 8/17/2026): brackets; the third and fourth brackets are both 4.55% in 2026

NE DOR Form 1040N (2026, draft as of 8/17/2026): standard deduction $8,850 / $17,700 / $8,850 / $12,950; personal exemption credit $176 per exemption; itemized = federal Schedule A less state and local income taxes
NE DOR 2025 Individual Income Tax Booklet: 65-or-blind standard deduction chart; itemize only if itemized federally
provisional: 2026 brackets, standard deduction and $176 exemption credit come from draft forms
65-and-over add-on is the 2025 married amount ($1,650 per person); 2025 single/head-of-household filers got $2,000, and 2026 amounts are not published
Property-tax cap uses the 2026 federal SALT cap ($40,400; $20,200 married filing separately)
notes: Nebraska subtracts all state income tax from the federal SALT-capped total, so above about $505,000 of income the property-tax deduction may be smaller than shown.
